name: Wowprime Corp.
summary: Wowprime Corp. operates restaurants and coffee/tea shops in Taiwan and Mainland China. The company engages in the retail sale of agricultural and livestock products, food products, and daily necessities; catering and catering management; investment activities; management consultancy; the sale of fresh food; and the manufacture of baked and steamed foods. It also provides restaurant services, including Western steak, Japanese-style cuisine, original grilled dishes, Hokkaido kelp hotpot, teppanyaki, Japanese pork chop, hot pot, and Italian veggie cuisine. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan.
